svg.title: Obsidian hero: Itzpapalotl, The Obsidian Butterfly, hovering over a terminal-lit altar
svg.desc: Original hero art for the Obsidian project, a corpus of multimodal, multi-turn, tool-using agent tasks. Itzpapalotl, The Obsidian Butterfly, a Mexica warrior goddess, hovers over a stone altar lit by teal terminal screens under a dusk sky of deep violet and volcanic orange. Her four obsidian-bladed wing panels each reflect one modality: a screenshot of application windows, a chart with bars and a line, a sound wave, and lines of an API request log. Three attendants stand for the project's three work orders: a memory goddess carving glyphs into a stone tablet, a daemoness smith knapping an obsidian blade at an anvil, and a molten goddess tending a lava crucible. Distant volcanic ridges smoke on the horizon and embers drift upward. One light falls from the upper left. The project name and a single tagline sit in the lower third.
